title: RAG Vector Store Management
summary: This module provides core functionalities for managing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) vector stores, including configuration, client creation for various providers like ChromaDB and Qdrant, and defining parameters for data interaction.

nodes.label: Manage RAG Module Configuration
nodes.title: RAG Module Wrapper
nodes.description: A module wrapper that intercepts attribute setting for RAG configuration, allowing dynamic configuration and submodule loading for the entire RAG system.

nodes.label: Define RAG System Configuration
nodes.title: RAG Configuration
nodes.description: Represents the centralized configuration for RAG providers, specifying settings for different vector database integrations like ChromaDB or Qdrant.

nodes.label: Generate Default ChromaDB Settings
nodes.title: ChromaDB Default Settings
nodes.description: Function to create default settings for ChromaDB, including persistence directory, allowing resets, and disabling anonymized telemetry.

nodes.label: Generate Default Qdrant Options
nodes.title: Qdrant Default Options
nodes.description: Function to create default client options for Qdrant, primarily for file-based storage, simplifying Qdrant client initialization.

nodes.label: Create RAG Client from Config
nodes.title: RAG Client Factory
nodes.description: A central factory function that creates a RAG client instance by dispatching to specific provider factories (e.g., ChromaDB, Qdrant) based on the provided RAG configuration.

nodes.label: Instantiate ChromaDB Client
nodes.title: ChromaDB Client Factory
nodes.description: Creates a ChromaDB client instance based on a ChromaDB-specific configuration, handling persistent storage setup and integrating embedding functions.

nodes.label: Instantiate Qdrant Client
nodes.title: Qdrant Client Factory
nodes.description: Creates a Qdrant client instance from a Qdrant-specific configuration, ensuring proper setup for interaction with the Qdrant vector database.

nodes.label: Define Base RAG Client Interface
nodes.title: Base RAG Client Interface
nodes.description: An abstract base class or interface that defines common methods and properties for all RAG vector store clients, ensuring consistency across different providers.

nodes.label: Protocol for Vector Embedding
nodes.title: Embedding Function Protocol
nodes.description: A protocol defining the interface for embedding functions, which convert input data (documents, images) into vector embeddings, including validation and normalization.

nodes.label: Wrap Qdrant Embedding Function
nodes.title: Qdrant Embedding Wrapper
nodes.description: A wrapper class for Qdrant's embedding functions, designed to ensure compatibility with Pydantic validation and the general EmbeddingFunction protocol.

nodes.label: Define Parameters for Adding Data
nodes.title: Collection Add Parameters
nodes.description: Defines the parameters required for adding documents to a vector collection, including the collection name, documents, and optional batch size for processing.

nodes.label: Define Parameters for Searching Data
nodes.title: Collection Search Parameters
nodes.description: Defines the parameters for searching within a vector collection, including the query, result limit, metadata filters, and a minimum similarity score threshold.

nodes.label: High-Level Qdrant Collection Params
nodes.title: Qdrant Collection Create Params
nodes.description: High-level parameters used for creating a Qdrant collection, extending base collection parameters with Qdrant-specific fields.

nodes.label: Low-Level Qdrant Collection Params
nodes.title: Qdrant Create Collection Params
nodes.description: Specific parameters directly used by the `qdrant_client.create_collection` method, including the collection name and other low-level settings.

nodes.label: ChromaDB Client Instance
nodes.title: ChromaDB Client
nodes.description: An instantiated client for ChromaDB, providing methods to interact with the ChromaDB vector store for adding, searching, and managing collections.

nodes.label: Qdrant Client Instance
nodes.title: Qdrant Client
nodes.description: An instantiated client for Qdrant, offering functionalities to interact with the Qdrant vector database for data storage, retrieval, and collection management.

nodes.label: Vector Database System
nodes.title: External Vector Database
nodes.description: The underlying external vector database system (e.g., ChromaDB, Qdrant) where embeddings and metadata are stored and indexed for efficient similarity search.

groups.label: Core RAG Module
groups.title: Core RAG Module
groups.description: The central module wrapper for managing RAG system configuration and dynamic loading.

groups.label: Configuration & Defaults
groups.title: Configuration & Defaults
groups.description: Components responsible for defining and providing default settings for RAG clients and providers.

groups.label: Client Provisioning
groups.title: Client Provisioning
groups.description: Factory components responsible for creating and configuring RAG client instances for specific vector database providers.

groups.label: Data Interaction Models
groups.title: Data Interaction Models
groups.description: Interfaces and parameter definitions for interacting with vector collections, including embedding functions and data operation parameters.

groups.label: Vector Store Clients
groups.title: Vector Store Clients
groups.description: Concrete client implementations for interacting with specific vector database systems.

groups.label: External Systems
groups.title: External Systems
groups.description: Represents the external vector database infrastructure that the RAG clients connect to.
